issue_context.title: BUG: DataFrame.convert_dtypes() drops the columns' name
issue_context.body:
- [x] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.

- [x] I have confirmed this bug exists on the latest version of pandas.

- [ ] (optional) I have confirmed this bug exists on the master branch of pandas.

#### Code Sample, a copy-pastable example

```python
import pandas as pd


df = pd.DataFrame({'a': [1, 2], 'b': [3, 4]})
df.columns.name = 'cols'
print(df)
# drops the columns' name 'cols'
print(df.convert_dtypes())

```

#### Problem description

DataFrame.convert_dtypes() drops the columns' name.
This is unexpected.

#### Expected Output

convert_dtypes() should keep the columns' name.
It does so for the index name.
